Subject: Revenue lockdown: morning validation & CRM changes

Liam —

Quick note as we enter the final two business days of Q4: we want to make sure Blue Pike is accounted for in the morning rollup. Two asks so we have clean forecasting for finance and sales ops:

- Can you confirm PO timeline (expected signature date + billing start)?
- Any changes to payment terms or SOW scope we should expect before we finalize the numbers?

Attached is the latest SOW (SOW_v3.pdf) and our short checklist so finance can verify ARR contribution. If you can reply with a one-line confirmation and the scanned PO, I’ll push the deal to Commit in HubSpot.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)

Alex —

Thanks for sending. We’re good to move forward but need one small tweak on payment terms: change Net30 to Net45; procurement flagged it for budget alignment. Scope is unchanged. I’ve attached a signed PO with our company stamp — hoping that’s sufficient to get you to Commit.

If Net45 requires any billing calendar changes on your side, flag them and I’ll route to finance immediately. Otherwise we expect legal to accept the SOW as-is.

Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance | Blue Pike AI
liam@bluepike.ai | +1 617-555-0117

Subject: Morning rollforward — Blue Pike (BP-4721) + action items for finance/sales ops

Team — good morning and quick rollforward for the morning commit sweep. This is the Blue Pike thread — they returned a signed PO (attached) but requested Net45. I’m flagging because payment terms change the billing start and revenue recognition schedule.

Summary (please confirm on thread):
- Account: Blue Pike AI (deal BP-4721)
- ARR contribution on SOW_v3: $185,000 ARR
- Signed PO received: signed-po-bluepike.pdf (attached) — expect signature date 2026-10-14
- Payment terms requested: Net45 (was Net30) — needs finance signoff for forecast calendar
- HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (please move to Commit if finance confirms)

Immediate ask to close the morning rollup and keep forecast tidy:
1) Laura — can you confirm if Net45 changes the recognized ARR for Q4 close? If revenue needs to be pushed to next period because billing starts in November, call that out.
2) Ben — once Laura confirms, please update deal stage to Commit (owner: alex.martinez) and set expected close date to 2026-10-15 or leave pending if finance requires billing adjustment.
3) Everyone — please mark the MorningLockdownChecklist (attached) as reviewed and add any notes directly in the HubSpot deal comments.

Quoted for context:

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Morning rollforward — Blue Pike (BP-4721) + action items for finance/sales ops

Alex / Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the SOW + signed PO and Net45 is acceptable for revenue booking, but it shifts the initial invoice date and therefore recognition into November for a portion of the implementation fee we had planned in Q4. Short answers:

- Confirmed ARR to count for Q4 commit: $160,000 (we will defer $25,000 of implementation revenue to Nov due to billing start date).
- Expected recognized revenue affecting Q4 forecast: $160k; rest flows to Nov.
- I’ve uploaded the redlined terms and our approval note: approved-terms-redlined.pdf (attached).

Action items complete:
- Alex: move to Commit in HubSpot and set expected close date to 2026-10-15, with a note: "Net45; $25k defer to Nov".
- Ben: capture finance note in deal comments and run the morning commit export for FP&A (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345).

If anyone wants a quick sync I can be on a 15-min call at 09:00 PT. Otherwise I’ll update the commit sheet and notify FP&A.

—Laura Bennett
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
